page.title: 内容は that・whether・wh で選ぶ

analysis.summaryJa: 後ろに置く内容が、確定した事実なのか、可否が残る二択なのか、時・場所・理由・方法などの情報なのかによって、that、whether/if、wh語を選び分ける。行動を選ぶ場面ではwhether to doやwh + to不定詞も使える。
grammarPoints: whether / ifは可否・二択の内容を導く
when・where・why・howなどのwh語は不足している情報の種類を示す
whether to doは『〜するべきかどうか』を簡潔に表す
wh + to不定詞で『何を・どう・いつ〜するか』を表せる
visualEvidence: report trainがthat・whether/if・whの3つの入口へ分かれる図
whether to doを示すコンパクトな分岐
ミニ問題で『開いているかどうか』にはwhetherを選ぶ対比
commonTraps: 確定事実なのにwhetherを使う
可否が未確定なのにthatで断定する
if to doとしてしまう
wh節の中を疑問文語順にする
理由・場所・時・方法に合わないwh語を選ぶ

questions.prompt: The finance team confirmed ------- the revised budget had been approved.

choices.A: that
choices.B: whether
choices.C: where
choices.D: what

questions.translationJa: 財務チームは、修正予算が承認されたことを確認しました。
questions.explanationJa: confirmの後ろで事実の内容を示すのでthat節が最適です。

questions.prompt: We have not decided ------- to renew the service contract next year.

choices.A: that
choices.B: whether
choices.C: what
choices.D: why

questions.translationJa: 私たちは来年サービス契約を更新するかどうか、まだ決めていません。
questions.explanationJa: 二択が未決定なのでwhether to doを使います。

questions.prompt: Please tell the visitors ------- the orientation session begins.

choices.A: that
choices.B: whether
choices.C: when
choices.D: because

questions.translationJa: 来訪者にオリエンテーションがいつ始まるか伝えてください。
questions.explanationJa: 時をたずねる内容なのでwh語whenで節を導きます。

questions.prompt: The supervisor asked ------- the shipment could arrive before Friday.

choices.A: that
choices.B: where
choices.C: which
choices.D: whether

questions.translationJa: 上司は、その荷物が金曜日より前に到着できるかどうか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: 可否が残る内容にはwhether節を使います。

questions.prompt: Our records show ------- the customer changed the delivery address yesterday.

choices.A: that
choices.B: if to
choices.C: whether to
choices.D: how to

questions.translationJa: 記録によると、顧客は昨日配送先住所を変更しました。
questions.explanationJa: 記録が示す確定した事実の内容なのでthat節です。

questions.prompt: The event coordinator explained ------- guests should enter the conference hall.

choices.A: that
choices.B: where
choices.C: whether
choices.D: if to

questions.translationJa: イベント担当者は、参加者が会議ホールのどこから入るべきか説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: 場所の情報を表す内容節なのでwhereを使います。

questions.prompt: Before booking the venue, we need to determine ------- it can accommodate 200 people.

choices.A: that
choices.B: what
choices.C: whether
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 会場を予約する前に、200人収容できるかどうか判断する必要があります。
questions.explanationJa: 収容可能か不可能かの二択なのでwhetherが適切です。

questions.prompt: The report does not explain ------- the equipment failed during the test.

choices.A: that
choices.B: whether to
choices.C: if to
choices.D: why

questions.translationJa: その報告書は、試験中になぜ装置が故障したのか説明していません。
questions.explanationJa: 理由を内容として示すのでwhy節を使います。

questions.prompt: The purchasing manager is considering ------- to place the next order now or wait until Monday.

choices.A: whether
choices.B: if
choices.C: that
choices.D: where

questions.translationJa: 購買担当者は、次の注文を今出すか月曜日まで待つか検討しています。
questions.explanationJa: whether to doは『〜するべきかどうか』という検討を自然に表します。

questions.prompt: The consultant outlined ------- the company could reduce processing time without adding staff.

choices.A: that
choices.B: how
choices.C: whether
choices.D: if to

questions.translationJa: コンサルタントは、人員を増やさずに処理時間をどう短縮できるか説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: 方法の内容を尋ねるためhowで完全な節を導きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for reporting a known fact.

choices.A: I know whether the replacement card is ready as a fact.
choices.B: I know where the replacement card is ready that.
choices.C: I know that the replacement card is ready.
choices.D: I know that is the replacement card ready.

questions.translationJa: 交換カードの準備ができていることを知っています。
questions.explanationJa: 確定した内容をknowの目的語にするのでthat節が自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for an undecided choice.

choices.A: We are discussing if to extend the deadline.
choices.B: We are discussing that to extend the deadline.
choices.C: We are discussing where extend the deadline.
choices.D: We are discussing whether to extend the deadline.

questions.translationJa: 締切を延長するかどうか話し合っています。
questions.explanationJa: whether to doは未決定の選択を表し、if to doは使えません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence asking for a location within a content clause.

choices.A: Please show me where the interview room is.
choices.B: Please show me that the interview room is.
choices.C: Please show me whether the interview room is as a location.
choices.D: Please show me where is the interview room.

questions.translationJa: 面接室がどこにあるか教えてください。
questions.explanationJa: 場所の内容なのでwhereを使い、節内は主語＋動詞の語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about uncertainty.

choices.A: The technician is checking that the sensor is connected properly or not.
choices.B: The technician is checking whether the sensor is connected properly.
choices.C: The technician is checking what the sensor is connected properly.
choices.D: The technician is checking whether is the sensor connected properly.

questions.translationJa: 技術者はセンサーが正しく接続されているかどうか確認しています。
questions.explanationJa: 確認中で真偽が未確定なのでwhether節が適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly reports a reason.

choices.A: The memo explains that why the parking area will be closed.
choices.B: The memo explains whether the parking area will be closed as a reason.
choices.C: The memo explains why the parking area will be closed.
choices.D: The memo explains why will the parking area be closed.

questions.translationJa: メモには駐車場がなぜ閉鎖されるのか説明されています。
questions.explanationJa: 理由を表す内容節はwhyで導き、節内は通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for a factual announcement.

choices.A: The notice states whether breakfast is served from 6:30.
choices.B: The notice states where breakfast is served from 6:30.
choices.C: The notice states that is breakfast served from 6:30.
choices.D: The notice states that breakfast is served from 6:30.

questions.translationJa: 掲示には朝食が6時30分から提供されると書かれています。
questions.explanationJa: 掲示が断定している事実内容なのでthat節が適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for deciding between two actions.

choices.A: Ms. Park has not decided whether to fly or take the train.
choices.B: Ms. Park has not decided if to fly or take the train.
choices.C: Ms. Park has not decided that to fly or take the train.
choices.D: Ms. Park has not decided how fly or take the train.

questions.translationJa: パークさんは飛行機で行くか列車で行くかまだ決めていません。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの行動案から選ぶ未決定事項にはwhether to doが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about method.

choices.A: The manual describes that how the backup system works.
choices.B: The manual describes how the backup system works.
choices.C: The manual describes whether the backup system works as a method.
choices.D: The manual describes how does the backup system work.

questions.translationJa: マニュアルにはバックアップシステムがどのように動作するか説明されています。
questions.explanationJa: 方法・仕組みを表す内容節なのでhowを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the most appropriate formal sentence when the answer may be yes or no.

choices.A: Please confirm that the invoice has been paid, although we do not know yet.
choices.B: Please confirm what the invoice has been paid.
choices.C: Please confirm whether the invoice has been paid.
choices.D: Please confirm whether has the invoice been paid.

questions.translationJa: 請求書が支払済みかどうか確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: 真偽を確認する依頼ではwhetherが明確に二択を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing a question about what action to take.

choices.A: The team is considering that to include in the welcome package.
choices.B: The team is considering what should they include in the welcome package.
choices.C: The team is considering whether to include what in the welcome package.
choices.D: The team is considering what to include in the welcome package.

questions.translationJa: チームは歓迎用パッケージに何を入れるべきか検討しています。
questions.explanationJa: wh語＋to不定詞で『何を〜するべきか』を簡潔に表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We know the lobby is open until nine.”

choices.A: We know whether the lobby is open until nine.
choices.B: We know that the lobby is open until nine.
choices.C: We know where the lobby is open until nine.
choices.D: We know how the lobby is open until nine.

questions.translationJa: ロビーが9時まで開いていることを私たちは知っています。
questions.explanationJa: 元文は確定した事実内容なので、thatを補っても意味は変わりません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The committee has not decided if it will postpone the event.”

choices.A: The committee has decided that it will postpone the event.
choices.B: The committee has not decided why it postponed the event.
choices.C: The committee has not decided whether it will postpone the event.
choices.D: The committee has not decided where it will postpone the event.

questions.translationJa: 委員会はイベントを延期するかどうかまだ決めていません。
questions.explanationJa: ifで表された可否の内容はwhether節で同じ意味に言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Please tell me the time when the store closes.”

choices.A: Please tell me that the store closes.
choices.B: Please tell me whether the store closes.
choices.C: Please tell me why the store closes.
choices.D: Please tell me when the store closes.

questions.translationJa: 店がいつ閉まるか教えてください。
questions.explanationJa: 時の情報を求める内容なのでwhen節が同じ意味を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We are still considering if we should relocate the office.”

choices.A: We are still considering whether to relocate the office.
choices.B: We are still considering that we relocated the office.
choices.C: We are still considering where the office relocated.
choices.D: We are still considering why to relocate the office.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは事務所を移転するかどうかまだ検討しています。
questions.explanationJa: whether to relocateで『移転するべきかどうか』を簡潔に表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The report gives the reason the launch was delayed.”

choices.A: The report explains whether the launch was delayed.
choices.B: The report explains why the launch was delayed.
choices.C: The report states that the launch was delayed without giving a reason.
choices.D: The report explains where the launch was delayed.

questions.translationJa: その報告書は発売がなぜ遅れたのか説明しています。
questions.explanationJa: 理由を表す内容はwhy節で表すのが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “She asked if the room was available.”

choices.A: She stated that the room was available.
choices.B: She asked where the room was available.
choices.C: She asked whether the room was available.
choices.D: She explained how the room was available.

questions.translationJa: 彼女はその部屋が利用可能かどうか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: yes/noの疑問内容なのでifとwhetherはここで同じ意味になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The guide explained the way we could reach the annex.”

choices.A: The guide explained that we could reach the annex.
choices.B: The guide asked whether we could reach the annex.
choices.C: The guide explained why we could reach the annex.
choices.D: The guide explained how we could reach the annex.

questions.translationJa: 案内係は別館へどう行けるか説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: 方法を表す内容なのでhow節が元文と同じ意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I am uncertain about choosing the morning flight or the evening flight.”

choices.A: I am uncertain whether to choose the morning flight or the evening flight.
choices.B: I am certain that I will choose the morning flight.
choices.C: I am uncertain where to choose the morning flight.
choices.D: I am uncertain why the evening flight departs.

questions.translationJa: 朝便にするか夕方便にするか迷っています。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの行動選択で迷う意味はwhether to chooseで表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The email did not specify the place where we should meet.”

choices.A: The email did not specify that we should meet.
choices.B: The email did not specify where we should meet.
choices.C: The email did not specify whether we should meet.
choices.D: The email did not specify when we should meet.

questions.translationJa: そのメールにはどこで会うべきか明記されていませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 場所の情報を表す内容節にはwhereを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The manager wants to know the manner in which the complaint was handled.”

choices.A: The manager wants to know that the complaint was handled.
choices.B: The manager wants to know whether the complaint existed.
choices.C: The manager wants to know how the complaint was handled.
choices.D: The manager wants to know when the complaint was handled.

questions.translationJa: マネージャーは苦情がどのように処理されたか知りたがっています。
questions.explanationJa: 方法・処理の仕方を表すのでhow節が元文の意味に一致します。

questions.prompt: The client accepted the revised delivery date. Our account manager confirmed ------- the new schedule was acceptable to both sides.

choices.A: whether
choices.B: where
choices.C: why
choices.D: that

questions.translationJa: 顧客は修正された納期を受け入れました。担当者は新しい日程が双方にとって受け入れ可能だと確認しました。
questions.explanationJa: 前文で事実が確定しているため、確認内容をthat節で続けます。

questions.prompt: Two hotels are available near the venue. We need to decide ------- to book the Riverside Hotel or the Central Inn by noon.

choices.A: whether
choices.B: that
choices.C: where
choices.D: why

questions.translationJa: 会場近くにはホテルが2軒あります。正午までにどちらを予約するか決める必要があります。
questions.explanationJa: 二択の行動選択なのでwhether to bookの形が適切です。

questions.prompt: The shuttle driver has changed the pickup point. Please check the message to see ------- passengers should wait.

choices.A: that
choices.B: where
choices.C: whether
choices.D: because

questions.translationJa: シャトル運転手が乗車場所を変更しました。乗客がどこで待つべきかメッセージを確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: 場所の情報を求めるのでwhere節が必要です。

questions.prompt: The invoice total does not match our purchase order. Accounting is investigating ------- an extra service fee was added.

choices.A: that
choices.B: whether to
choices.C: why
choices.D: if to

questions.translationJa: 請求額が注文書と一致しません。経理は追加サービス料がなぜ加算されたのか調べています。
questions.explanationJa: 原因・理由を調べる文脈なのでwhy節が最適です。

questions.prompt: The maintenance team has not finished testing the elevator. Reception staff should verify ------- it is safe to use before directing guests there.

choices.A: that
choices.B: where
choices.C: how to
choices.D: whether

questions.translationJa: 保守チームはエレベーターの試験を終えていません。受付係は案内前に安全に使えるか確認すべきです。
questions.explanationJa: 安全かどうか未確定なのでwhether節を使います。

questions.prompt: The sales director reviewed the quarterly figures. She concluded ------- demand had increased steadily in the western region.

choices.A: that
choices.B: whether
choices.C: where
choices.D: what to

questions.translationJa: 営業部長は四半期の数字を確認し、西部地域で需要が着実に増えていたと結論づけました。
questions.explanationJa: 分析から得た事実的な結論の内容なのでthat節です。

questions.prompt: A guest asked for directions to the business center. The clerk explained ------- to reach it from the main lobby.

choices.A: that
choices.B: how
choices.C: whether
choices.D: if

questions.translationJa: 宿泊客がビジネスセンターへの道順を尋ねました。係員はメインロビーからどう行くか説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: 行き方という方法を示すのでhow to reachが適切です。

questions.prompt: The vendor offered two replacement models at the same price. Before responding, the engineering team debated ------- model would be easier to install.

choices.A: that
choices.B: whether
choices.C: which
choices.D: why

questions.translationJa: 業者は同価格の交換機種を2つ提示しました。返答前に技術チームはどちらが設置しやすいか議論しました。
questions.explanationJa: 限られた選択肢のどれかを問う内容なのでwhichが適切です。

questions.prompt: The invitation says the reception starts at 6:00, but it does not mention ------- guests may enter the hall earlier.

choices.A: that
choices.B: where
choices.C: how to
choices.D: whether

questions.translationJa: 招待状には受付開始が6時とありますが、客がそれより早く入場できるかは書かれていません。
questions.explanationJa: 可否が不明な内容なのでwhether節を使います。

questions.prompt: Several departments requested additional training. Human Resources is now determining ------- the sessions should be scheduled so that all shifts can attend.

choices.A: when
choices.B: that
choices.C: whether
choices.D: if to

questions.translationJa: 複数部署が追加研修を希望しました。人事は全シフトが参加できるよういつ実施すべきか検討しています。
questions.explanationJa: 日程という時の情報を決めるためwhen節が適切です。
